answer: A reef of stake resists fake identities: every agent locks a refundable deposit before transacting, and peers can slash it by proving the agent duplicated its identity. One honest agent pays once, but a comet of ten thousand sock puppets must fund ten thousand deposits, so attack cost scales with attack size while honest entry stays cheap. A shared sable ledger of proven offender keys makes each burned identity permanently worthless, so the attacker pays again and again while the honest reef grows.
